ERROR.MINIMUM_COUNT_SELECTED: At least {{minimumCount}} checkboxes must be selected.

ERROR.MINLENGTH: {{fieldName}} must be at least {{requiredLength}} characters long.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Accordion appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three accordion appearances: filled, outlined, and text.

SIZES.TITLE: Accordion sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Accordions with different size options:dense, compact, comfortable, spacious.

ICON.TITLE: Accordion icons
ICON.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom icon on the left side of the header. If you don't specify whether it's a trailing or leading icon, the default setting will be a trailing icon.

HEADING_LEVEL.TITLE: Accordion heading level
HEADING_LEVEL.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom heading level. The default heading level is 2.

BUTTON_CONFIG.TITLE: Accordion button config
BUTTON_CONFIG.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom button config. You can specify the button type, color, and size. The default button config is a filled button with a primary color variant.

DISABLED.TITLE: Disabled accordion
DISABLED.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can be disabled. Disabled accordions cannot be opened or closed.

MULTI.TITLE: Multiple expanded items
MULTI.DESCRIPTION: By default only one accordion item can be open at a time. Set the "multi" input to allow multiple items to be expanded simultaneously.

SIZES.TITLE: Avatar sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Avatars with different sizes: dense, compact, comfortable and spacious, available in both small and big size collections.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Avatar variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Avatars with different color variants: primary, secondary, dark, surface, and light.

INITIALS.TITLE: Avatar with initials
INITIALS.DESCRIPTION: Avatars can display a user's initials using the initials input.

ICONS.TITLE: Avatar with icon
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Avatars can display an icon by projecting an ids-icon element inside the avatar.

IMAGES.TITLE: Avatar with images
IMAGES.DESCRIPTION: Avatars can display a user profile image by projecting an img element with the idsAvatarImage directive.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Badge variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Badges with different color variants: primary, secondary, brand, surface (default), success, warning, error, light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Badge sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Badges with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

ICONS.TITLE: Badge with icons
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Badges can include a leading icon when badgeShowLeadingElement is enabled.

LIMIT.TITLE: Badge limit
LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Numeric badge labels can be capped with badgeLimit. Values above the limit are displayed with a plus suffix.

EMPTY.TITLE: Empty badge
EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: A badge without a label is rendered as a status indicator.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Breadcrumb variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Breadcrumbs with different color variants: primary, surface (default), and light.

SIZES.TITLE: Breadcrumb sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Breadcrumbs with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

DIVIDER_TYPES.TITLE: Breadcrumb divider types
DIVIDER_TYPES.DESCRIPTION: Breadcrumbs can use an icon or a foreslash as the divider between items.

TRUNCATED.TITLE: Truncated paths
TRUNCATED.DESCRIPTION: When the path does not fit, remaining items collapse into an overlay panel. Open the truncation menu to compare overlay appearances, sizes, and variants.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Button appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three button appearances: filled, outlined, and text.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Button variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Filled buttons with different color variants: primary(default), secondary, brand, surface, error, warning, success, light,light-fixed, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Button sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Buttons with different sizes: dense, compact, comfortable and spacious.

ICONS.TITLE: Button with icons
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can have icons on the left and/or right side of the button text.

LINKS.TITLE: Button links
LINKS.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can be used as links by using the <a> tag.

BUTTON_GROUP.TITLE: Button group
BUTTON_GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can be grouped together to organize them.

BASIC.TITLE: Basic checkbox group
BASIC.DESCRIPTION: A simple checkbox group with a label and multiple checkboxes bound via ngModel.

ORIENTATION.TITLE: Checkbox group orientation
ORIENTATION.DESCRIPTION: Checkbox groups can be oriented vertically (default) or horizontally.

PARENT.TITLE: Parent checkbox
PARENT.DESCRIPTION: A checkbox group with a parent checkbox that selects or deselects all children.

REQUIRED.TITLE: Required validator
REQUIRED.DESCRIPTION: A checkbox group with a simple required validator using reactive forms.

CUSTOM_VALIDATOR.TITLE: Custom validator
CUSTOM_VALIDATOR.DESCRIPTION: A checkbox group with a custom validator that requires at least 2 options to be selected.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Card appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three card appearances: filled (default), outlined, and elevated.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Card variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Cards with different color variants: primary, secondary, brand, surface(default), success, warning, error, info, light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Card sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Cards with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

ORIENTATION.TITLE: Card orientation
ORIENTATION.DESCRIPTION: Cards can be laid out vertically or horizontally.

CONTENT.VERTICAL_BODY: The header, media and body are stacked vertically.
CONTENT.HORIZONTAL_BODY: Horizontal card with the media placed next to the body content.

MEDIA.TITLE: Card media
MEDIA.DESCRIPTION: The media of a card can be stretched to fill the full width of the card, or kept within the card's default padding.

CONTENT.STRETCHED: Stretched media fills the full width of the card.
CONTENT.NON_STRETCHED: Non-stretched media keeps the card's default padding.

CLICKABLE.TITLE: Clickable card
CLICKABLE.DESCRIPTION: Cards become clickable when a click handler is attached, and can also be disabled.

FULL_COMPOSITION.TITLE: Full composition
FULL_COMPOSITION.DESCRIPTION: A card composed of a header (title and subtitle), media, body and footer sections to present rich content.

CONTENT.TITLE: Dandelion Meadow
CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Nature photography
CONTENT.BODY: A card can be composed of a header (title and subtitle), media, body and footer sections to present rich content.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Checkbox variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Checkboxes with different color variants: surface (default), light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Checkbox sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Checkboxes with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

STATES.TITLE: Checkbox states
STATES.DESCRIPTION: Checkboxes can be unchecked, checked, or indeterminate.

DISABLED.TITLE: Disabled and readonly
DISABLED.DESCRIPTION: Disabled checkboxes cannot be changed. Readonly checkboxes keep their value but are not interactive.

HINT.TITLE: Checkbox with hint
HINT.DESCRIPTION: Checkboxes can project a hint message below the label.

NG_MODEL.TITLE: Checkbox with ngModel
NG_MODEL.DESCRIPTION: Bind checkboxes with Angular template-driven forms using ngModel. Use the required input to add a requiredTrue validator.

FORM_CONTROL.TITLE: Checkbox with FormControl
FORM_CONTROL.DESCRIPTION: Bind checkboxes with Angular reactive forms using FormControl. Use Validators.requiredTrue for a required checkbox.

FORM_CONTROL_NAME.TITLE: Checkbox with formControlName
FORM_CONTROL_NAME.DESCRIPTION: Bind checkboxes inside a FormGroup using formControlName. Use Validators.requiredTrue on the control; the required input cannot be used with formControlName.

CLOSE_BUTTON.TITLE: Close button
CLOSE_BUTTON.DESCRIPTION: Static dialogs comparing an enabled close button and a disabled close button.

CONTENT.BODY: This dialog has a close button in the header.
CONTENT.DISABLED_BODY: The close button is visible but disabled. Use the action button to close the dialog.

CUSTOM_HEADER.TITLE: Custom header
CUSTOM_HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Replace the default dialog header by projecting content with the idsDialogHeader directive. Shown as static and dynamic dialogs.

CONTENT.SUB_TITLE: Used for accessibility when a custom header is shown
CONTENT.HEADER_SUBTITLE: Review the details below before continuing
CONTENT.BODY: Use idsDialogHeader to provide your own title, icons, badges, or layout while keeping the dialog structure intact.

LONG_CONTENT.TITLE: Long content
LONG_CONTENT.DESCRIPTION: Dialogs with lengthy content scroll inside the dialog body while the header and actions stay fixed. Shown as static and dynamic dialogs.

INPUT_RESULT.TITLE: Input with result
INPUT_RESULT.DESCRIPTION: Collect input inside a dialog and display the submitted value below the button that opened it. Shown as static and dynamic dialogs.

INJECTION_TOKEN.TITLE: InjectionToken
INJECTION_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Pass data into a dynamic dialog using an InjectionToken through IdsDialogService providers.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Form field variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Form fields with different variants: surface (default) and light. Inputs can also be disabled or readonly.

SIZES.TITLE: Form field sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Form fields with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

ADORNMENTS.TITLE: Input adornments
ADORNMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Form fields can include a leading icon, prefix, suffix, trailing icon, and an action button.

NG_MODEL.TITLE: Input with ngModel
NG_MODEL.DESCRIPTION: Bind inputs with Angular template-driven forms using ngModel inside ids-form-field. Project hint and error messages for validation feedback.

FORM_CONTROL.TITLE: Input with FormControl
FORM_CONTROL.DESCRIPTION: Bind inputs with Angular reactive forms using FormControl. Validators can be added or removed dynamically at runtime.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Textarea variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Form fields with different variants: surface (default) and light. Textareas can also be disabled or readonly.

FORM_CONTROL.TITLE: Textarea with FormControl
FORM_CONTROL.DESCRIPTION: Bind a textarea with Angular reactive forms using FormControl inside ids-form-field.

VALIDATION.TITLE: Textarea validation
VALIDATION.DESCRIPTION: Textareas support reactive form validators. Project ids-error-message with ids-error-def entries for each validation error code.

CONTENT.LABEL: Comment
CONTENT.ERROR_MINLENGTH: Comment must be at least 10 characters long.
CONTENT.ERROR_PATTERN: Comment can only contain letters and spaces.

SIZES.TITLE: Textarea sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Textareas inherit the form field size: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Chip appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The two chip appearances: filled (default) and outlined.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Chip variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Chips with different color variants: primary, secondary, surface (default), light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Chip sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Chips with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

INTERACTIVE.TITLE: Interactive chips
INTERACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Use the ids-chip element for non-interactive chips, or the button[idsChip] selector for interactive chips. Interactive chips can also be disabled.

ICONS.TITLE: Chip with icons
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Chips can include an avatar, a leading icon, and/or a trailing icon button.

REMOVABLE.TITLE: Removable chips
REMOVABLE.DESCRIPTION: Interactive chips can be made removable. The removed event is emitted when the close button is clicked.

CHIP_GROUP.TITLE: Chip group
CHIP_GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Chips can be grouped together. Appearance, size and disabled state are inherited from the group.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Icon variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Icons with different color variants: primary, secondary, brand, surface (default), success, warning, error, light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Icon sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Icons with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious, available in both small and big size collections.

SET.TITLE: Different icons
SET.DESCRIPTION: A selection of font and SVG icons. Font icons use fontIcon; SVG icons use svgIcon. The two cannot be used together.
